description: Guide price for pitch and persons (category, adults, nights). The adults included in the base price are given per category (included_adults); every additional person aged 15 or older pays a per-person rate plus the local tourist levy per night. Children up to 14 are free. Extras such as electricity are NOT included and are added in the booking form, where the binding amount appears. / Richtpreis ohne Extras; inklusive Erwachsene je Kategorie laut included_adults.
